newsitem.title: UK: "For Sale" sign on London's Carnaby Street - FT.
newsitem.headline: "For Sale" sign on London's Carnaby Street - FT.

text.p: Carnaby Street, London's world-famous shopping street, is to be sold by Dutch property group Wereldhave, the Financial Times reported in its Monday edition.

It said the three-acre West End site, which became renowned in the "swinging sixties" as a fashionable shopping venue, was bought by the Dutch company in 1988 in a 282 million stg hostile takeover of UK property company Peachy Properties.

It said Wereldhave wants at least 69 million stg for the site. The sale of the Carnaby Street estate, which earns annual rental income of around 5.8 million stg, is the part of a shift by the company into housing and apartment complexes, it added.
